design: Fixed before the deep-run outcomes were generated. Synthetic Gaussian two-candidate shared-frame retrieval, parity, clean first selected sign C1, final-label noise 0.10.
primary: Clean hard polar-deployment error difference, auxiliary minus final, at 131072 total labels, depth 9, Adam rate .02; two-sided exact sign test over independent paired teachers (ties omitted), teacher-paired percentile bootstrap 95% CI (50000 draws, seed 721001).
secondary: Report the same comparison at both depths and both historical rates, plus equal-examples comparisons at 131072 examples. Only the primary test is confirmatory. Report individual differences and descriptive paired bootstrap intervals for all cells.
crossing: First evaluated checkpoint with clean error <=10%, independent of training decisions. Count reaches and report the two central order statistics including right-censoring. Compare at common label cap 131072 as well as full example cap. No censor-imputed speedup.
sharing: Fresh online examples used once per model. Within each paired teacher and depth, common training, initial weights and holdout across arms and rates. No early stopping or optimizer tuning.
scope: A measured difference is specific to this synthetic Gaussian experiment and optimizer. A finite-budget result and finite depth cannot estimate the SQ precision exponent or demonstrate asymptotic separation.
